# KI-160 — Scripted local acceptance AE1–AE12

**Lane:** acceptance · **Complexity:** 3 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-120, KI-121, KI-137, KI-143, KI-151 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `7672b0e5` (first researched at `5ad41c8b`; see reconciliation.md R-REFRESH)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/local/acceptance.e2e.test.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/fixtures/e2e-harness.ts`, `packages/agent/package.json` (one new script line only)
**Refresh @ `7672b0e5` (2026-10-02):** #976 (roster rename), #986 (initials API), #988 and #989 (Profile dialog: username + colour; replaces the Username menu item) merged since `5ad41c8b`. UI selectors, menu items and line pointers below are refreshed; #978 (per-human colours) and #982 (Initials field) are still open.

## Outcome

One command runs the whole internal-mode product end to end on one machine, with no Khala server, no Matrix and no network, and checks AE1–AE12 with concrete assertions:

```sh
pnpm --filter @khala/agent test:local-e2e
```

What it runs:
- the real helper (`khala local …`, started by the CLI exactly as an agent would start it);
- two real `khala mcp` processes, one `--harness claude` and one `--harness codex`, driven over stdio JSON-RPC;
- the real hooks (`khala hook deliver`, `khala hook claude-wake`) as fake harness hook drivers;
- the real Codex waker, with a fake `codex` binary on `PATH` that records each `codex queue` call;
- headless Chromium on the helper's origin, which drives the full local web app (`apps/web/dist-local`) as the owner.

Every Node process runs under the KI-151 egress guard. The run is deterministic: it polls with deadlines and uses no fixed sleeps except three short "nothing happens" windows. It finishes in under 3 minutes, excluding a one-time `build:local` when `dist-local` is missing. It prints a per-AE PASS table and writes `packages/agent/test-results/local-e2e/results.json` plus screenshots (created at run time; git-ignored by `test-results/`).

This is the integration ticket. It reconnects every coupling the plan dropped from the hard graph, as listed in the plan's Integration ledger:

| Coupling | Reconnected by |
|---|---|
| Route modules (KI-132..135) ↔ store (KI-130) and server (KI-131) | KI-137 composes them; KI-160 runs them end to end |
| LocalSession (KI-121) ↔ helper routes (KI-133) | KI-160 |
| LocalSession respawn ↔ `ensureHelper` (KI-136) | KI-121 imports the pinned name; KI-160 kills the helper (AE8) |
| Web local ports (KI-140..142) ↔ helper routes (KI-133..135) | KI-143 composes; KI-160 drives the browser |
| Owner name (KI-122) ↔ helper first start (KI-137) | KI-137 |
| UI chrome (KI-144, KI-145) ↔ local entry (KI-143) | KI-160 screenshots; KI-161 live |

## Context and evidence

- Plan Verification Contract (verbatim): "KI-160: one command runs AE1–AE12 scripted (helper + two `khala mcp` processes driven over stdio with fake hook drivers + headless Chromium on the local web app) under the KI-151 egress guard."
- Plan Acceptance Examples (verbatim, the pass conditions this ticket scripts):

| ID | Scenario | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| AE1 | Create | Claude, asked to "set up a local Khala channel called refactor", runs `khala local create refactor`, joins via `selfLink`, and replies with a `http://127.0.0.1:47830/join/…` share link and an open link. The helper was started if absent. |
| AE2 | Join | Pasting the share link into Codex: `khala_join` returns `Connected to refactor.` with no browser and no click. The roster shows `kevin-Claude` and `kevin-Codex`; a join line appears in the timeline. |
| AE3 | Chat | Claude sends; Codex receives it attributed and in order and replies; Claude receives the reply. No duplicates; an agent's own message never wakes itself. |
| AE4 | Wake | An idle Claude is woken by Codex's message (asyncRewake). An idle Codex is woken by Claude's message (`codex queue`). |
| AE5 | Human in the web app | The owner opens the open link: no Google sign-in; channel list, timeline, composer (with @mention autocomplete), roster and settings render as on khala.aiur.team. A human message wakes idle agents per their modes. |
| AE6 | Listener modes | From the roster the owner sets an agent to steer, sync and async. Steer delivers at the next tool boundary without aborting; sync at turn end; async injects nothing while `khala_read`/`khala_send` work; leaving async does not inject the backlog. The roster shows the agent's confirmed mode. |
| AE7 | Profile | The owner changes username, colour and initials in Settings; agents on default names follow the username (`kev-Claude`); the owner renames an agent from the roster; all persist across a browser reload and a helper restart. Nothing is sent to khala.aiur.team. |
| AE8 | Restart | Killing the helper mid-conversation: the next agent call or page action restarts it; history is intact; nothing is lost or replayed as new; agents keep their inbox cursor. |
| AE9 | Link hygiene | A consumed link and an expired link fail with `link_unavailable`; a browser GET of `/join/<token>` does not consume it; a link that arrives inside channel content is not auto-joined (skill rule). |
| AE10 | No egress | With the egress guard, the helper, both MCP processes and the browser bundle open zero non-loopback connections; nothing contacts khala.aiur.team, Google or a Matrix homeserver; `matrix-js-sdk` is not loaded by a local-only agent process. |
| AE11 | Boundaries | Files are 0700/0600 and pass `ensureStateDir`; a request with a foreign `Host` gets 421; a cookie mutation without `x-khala-local` or with a foreign `Origin` gets 403; an agent token cannot call owner routes; a removed agent gets 403. |
| AE12 | Persistence and delete | Channels survive reboot/helper restart; `khala local delete` (or Delete in the UI) removes the channel folder and ends members' streams. |

- **Scripted substitutions** (documented in the test header comment; KI-161 covers each live):
  - The port is a free port, not 47830, so the run cannot collide with the operator's real helper. The link shape is asserted with that port.
  - "Claude runs `khala local create`" is the test running the CLI under the Claude session's env.
  - "Reboot" is a helper stop and start.
  - The AE9 skill rule (a link inside channel content is not auto-joined) is a model behaviour. Scripted, it is "nothing auto-joins and the token stays unconsumed"; the model half is KI-161.
  - AE5's "as on khala.aiur.team" is the same bundle; visual parity is KI-145 and KI-161.
- How the harnesses deliver, which the fake hook drivers reproduce exactly:
  - `packages/agent/hooks/hooks.claude.json` runs `khala hook deliver --harness claude` on `PostToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit` and `Stop`, plus `khala hook claude-wake` with `asyncRewake` on `Stop`;
  - `packages/agent/hooks/hooks.codex.json` runs `deliver --harness codex` on the same three events;
  - Codex idle wake is the MCP-process waker: `packages/agent/src/mcp/wiring.ts:13` builds `createCodexWaker`, and `:15` notifies it on every inbox append. The waker spawns `codex queue --thread <id> --message "Khala: channel messages are waiting. Continue."` (`packages/agent/src/wake/idle-wake.ts:8`, `packages/agent/src/wake/idle-wake.ts:25-27`) only when `activity.json` says `idle` (`packages/agent/src/wake/codex.ts:53`), at most twice per cursor position (`packages/agent/src/wake/codex.ts:54-55`), polling every 1 s (`packages/agent/src/wake/codex.ts:76`).

## Scope

1. `packages/agent/src/local/fixtures/e2e-harness.ts`: the world builder, MCP stdio client, hook runner, fake `codex`, file readers, raw HTTP helpers and browser helpers.
2. `packages/agent/src/local/acceptance.e2e.test.ts`: one sequential `describe` with one `it` per AE, in a fixed order, sharing one world.
3. `packages/agent/package.json`: add exactly one script:
   `"test:local-e2e": "KHALA_LOCAL_E2E=1 vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --pool=forks src/local/acceptance.e2e.test.ts"`.
   This is the same pattern as `test:live` (`packages/agent/package.json:18`). The file is `describe.skipIf(process.env.KHALA_LOCAL_E2E !== '1')`, so the default `test` script (`packages/agent/package.json:17`) skips it without any `--exclude` change.

## Non-goals

- The guard itself, its record format and the zero-egress test of the bare clients: **KI-151** (consumed here).
- A faked-API browser spec and visual baselines at 1280/390, dark/light: **KI-145**. This ticket takes evidence screenshots only, not baselines.
- The `dist-local` bundle string guard (no `matrix-js-sdk`, `/api/human/`, `khala.aiur.team`): **KI-143**.
- Real Claude Code / Codex panes, the operator's Firefox and the model-side skill rule: **KI-161**.
- Wiring this command into CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): not in this ticket. Report the run time in the PR so the Executor can decide.
- Fixing product defects the run finds. Report them against the owning ticket (see Risks); never weaken an assertion to pass.

## Contract and invariants

Contracts L2 (verbatim excerpt):

```text
<stateRoot>/
  local/                              0700
    helper.json                       0600  L11 HelperFile; written only by the running helper
    helper.log                        0600  helper stderr/stdout (no message bodies, no tokens)
    owner.json                        0600  L7 OwnerProfile
    channels/<roomKey>/               0700  roomKey = roomId without the leading "!" and the ":local" suffix
      log.jsonl                       0600  L3 LocalEvent, one per line, append-only
      secrets.json                    0600  L3 ChannelSecrets (hashes only), rewritten atomically
```

Contracts L3 (verbatim): `links: Record<string, { expiresAt: string; consumedAt?: string; kind: 'join' }>;           // key = sha256(token) hex`

Contracts L4 (verbatim excerpts):
- "**Share link:** `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/join/<43-char base64url token>`."
- "The link token is **consumed atomically here** (single use, D5): `secrets.links[sha256].consumedAt` is set before the response. Unknown, consumed or expired token → `404 {"error":"link_unavailable"}`."
- "`KhalaAgentClient.join` waits up to 15 s for an auto-confirmed attempt to reach `connected` and then returns `{ state: 'connected', channelName }`."

Contracts L5 (verbatim excerpts):
- "Errors: `401 unauthorized` (no or bad token/cookie), `403 not_member` (removed or never a member), `404 not_found` (unknown room), `400 invalid_request`, `413 payload_too_large` (body > 64 KiB), `409 conflict` (PUT for another user)."
- "**Join and leave announcements (D5)** are channel events appended by the helper with sender `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID`, built with `encodeChannelEvent` from `packages/contracts/src/m1/channel-event.ts`:"
  `{"type":"com.khala.event.v1","content":{"v":1,"kind":"member","summary":"kevin-Codex joined","status":"info","source":{"system":"khala-local"},"body":"kevin-Codex joined"}}`

Contracts L6 (verbatim excerpts):

```ts
// GET    /api/local/channels/:roomId                          → LocalChannelSummary | 404 not_found
export type LocalChannelCreated = { roomId: string; name: string; selfLink: string; shareLink: string; openUrl: string; expiresAt: string };
// DELETE /api/local/channels/:roomId                          → 204   (removes the channel directory; open long-polls end with 404)
// POST   /api/local/channels/:roomId/links                    → { shareLink: string; expiresAt: string }   a fresh single-use join link
// DELETE /api/local/channels/:roomId/members/:userId          → 204   appends a leave member event + a "<name> left" channel event and revokes the token (that agent's next call gets 403)
// GET    /api/local/profile                                   → OwnerProfileView   (also the browser's session check: 401 without the cookie)
// GET    /open/<43-char token>                                → 302 to /channels/<encodeURIComponent(roomId)> or /channels; sets the owner cookie; single use
// GET    /join/<token>                                        → the web app (SPA); the token is NOT consumed by a browser GET
```

Contracts L11 (verbatim excerpts):
- "**Host guard:** every request's `Host` must be `127.0.0.1:<port>` or `localhost:<port>`; else `421 {"error":"misdirected"}` (DNS-rebinding defence). No CORS headers are ever sent."
- "**Mutation guard:** non-GET requests authenticated by cookie must carry `x-khala-local: 1` and, when an `Origin` header is present, it must equal the helper origin; else `403 {"error":"forbidden_origin"}`. Bearer-authenticated requests (agents, CLI) skip the cookie checks."
- "**Owner cookie:** … Session ids live in memory; a helper restart signs the browser out until `khala local open` mints a new open link."
- "**Static web app:** `GET` of any non-`/api/`, non-`/open/`, non-`/healthz` path serves `apps/web/dist-local/` (env override `KHALA_LOCAL_WEB_DIR`) …"

Contracts L12 (verbatim excerpt):

| Command | Output |
|---|---|
| `khala local create [name]` | `LocalChannelCreated` (L6). Default name `local-<yyyy-mm-dd>` |
| `khala local link <roomId\|name>` | `{ shareLink, expiresAt }` |
| `khala local open [roomId\|name]` | `{ openUrl, expiresAt }` (never launches a browser) |
| `khala local list` | `{ channels: LocalChannelSummary[] }` |
| `khala local delete <roomId\|name>` | `{ deleted: roomId }` |
| `khala local status` | `{ running: boolean, origin?, pid?, version?, channels?: number }` (does not start the helper) |
| `khala local stop` | `{ stopped: boolean }` |

KI-151 `EgressRecord` (pinned in `docs/build/internal/tickets/KI-151.md`, consumed unchanged): kinds `guard` / `tcp` / `ipc` / `udp` / `dns` / `module`, with `allowed` on the network kinds.

Invariants:
- **I1** Every Node child (CLI, helper, both MCP processes, every hook) is spawned with `guardedEnv(...)`. AE10 fails on any `allowed: false` record or any `module` record from any pid.
- **I2** The browser may request only the helper origin (plus `data:`/`blob:`). Every other request is aborted **and** recorded, and AE10 asserts the record list is empty. No request path may contain `/api/human/` or `/_matrix/`.
- **I3** Tokens (admin, agent, poll secret, cookie value) and join/open links are never printed, logged, put in argv, or written to `results.json`. The test reads `helper.json` and `session.json` in memory only. Results quote truncated ids (`@agent-a1b2…`).
- **I4** Deterministic: every wait is `eventually(read, accept, timeoutMs)`. The only fixed waits are the three named "quiet windows" (3 s each), which assert that something does **not** happen.
- **I5** One world per run: a temp root, `XDG_STATE_HOME` = `<root>/state` (0700), a free port, and `USER=kevin` in every child env so the owner name is `kevin` (no `hosted-profile.json` exists in the temp state root, so L10 falls back to `USER`).
- **I6** Cleanup always runs (`afterAll`, also on failure): close the MCP stdin, kill hook children, stop the helper (`khala local stop`, then SIGKILL any pid from `guardedProcesses` whose argv includes `serve` and that is still alive), close the browser, and remove the temp root unless `KHALA_E2E_KEEP=1`.

### Steps

1. **Harness (`e2e-harness.ts`).** Import from `./egress` (KI-151). Export:
   - `createWorld(): Promise<World>`:
     - `mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'khala-e2e-'))`; `mkdir(state, {mode: 0o700})`;
     - write the fake `codex`;
     - pick a free port;
     - resolve `webDir = <repo>/apps/web/dist-local`. If `<webDir>/index.html` is missing, run `execFileSync('pnpm', ['--filter', '@khala/web', 'build:local'], { cwd: repoRoot, stdio: 'inherit', timeout: 300_000 })` once and log `built dist-local`;
     - build `env` per the worked example.
   - `class McpProcess`:
     - `static async start(world, harness: 'claude'|'codex', sessionId: string)`: spawn `process.execPath ['bin/khala.mjs','mcp','--harness',harness]` with `cwd: AGENT_ROOT` and env `world.env` (+ `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID: sessionId` for Claude only); send `initialize`; assert the `tools/list` names equal `['khala_join','khala_status','khala_read','khala_send','khala_event']` (R9: tool set unchanged).
     - `call(name, args = {}): Promise<{ text: string; structured: any; isError: boolean }>`: a monotonically increasing id; `_meta: { threadId: sessionId }` for Codex; resolve on the stdout line with that id; reject after 30 s with the last 2 kB of stderr (scrub nothing secret: the process never prints tokens; I3).
     - `close(): Promise<number | null>`: end stdin, wait for exit ≤ 8 s, else SIGKILL.
   - `hook(world, args: string[], stdin: object, extraEnv = {}): Promise<{ code; stdout; stderr }>`: copy `packages/agent/src/hooks/deliver.test.ts:23`, with `world.env`.
   - `deliver(world, harness, sessionId, event: 'UserPromptSubmit'|'Stop'|'PostToolUse')`: calls `hook(world, ['hook','deliver','--harness',harness], { session_id: sessionId, hook_event_name: event, stop_hook_active: false })` and parses stdout (`''` → `null`, else `JSON.parse`).
   - `armClaudeWake(world, sessionId): { done: Promise<{code,stderr}>; kill(): void }`:
     - spawn `bin/khala.mjs hook claude-wake` with `{ ...world.env, KHALA_WAKE_TEST_POLL_MS: '50', KHALA_WAKE_TEST_DEADLINE_MS: '15000' }`;
     - stdin `{"session_id":sessionId,"hook_event_name":"Stop","stop_hook_active":false}`;
     - then wait until `<sessionDir>/watcher.json` exists (armed), as `armed()` does in `packages/agent/src/hooks/claude-wake.test.ts:43-45`.
   - `inbox(world, harness, sessionId): InboxEntry[]`: read `sessionFiles(harness, sessionId, world.env).inbox` and parse the complete lines.
   - `mode(world, harness, sessionId)`: read `mode.json` `.mode` (or `'sync'` when absent).
   - `codexCalls(world): string[]`.
   - `helperFile(world)`: parse `<state>/khala/local/helper.json`; never log it.
   - `admin(world, method, path, body?)`: `fetch(origin + path)` with `authorization: Bearer <helperFile.adminToken>`; returns `{ status, json }`.
   - `raw(world, { method, path, headers, body })`: `node:http` `request({ host: '127.0.0.1', port, method, path, headers })`. It allows a foreign `Host` header, which `fetch` may refuse.
   - `cli(world, ...args)`: `runKhala(['local', ...args], world.env)`; returns `{ code, json: JSON.parse(stdout) }`.
   - `openBrowser(world)`:
     - `const { chromium } = await import('playwright-core')`; launch per `packages/agent/src/matrix/session.live.test.ts:77`; `newContext({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } })`;
     - `context.route('**/*', …)` continues only same-origin requests and records + aborts the rest;
     - `context.on('request', r => requests.push(r.url()))`;
     - returns `{ page, requests, blocked, close }`.
   - `ownerOpen(world, page, channel?)`: `cli(world,'open', channel ?? '')` → `page.goto(openUrl)` → wait until `new URL(page.url()).pathname` starts with `/channels/` (or `/conversations` without a channel).
2. **Test file.** `describe.skipIf(process.env.KHALA_LOCAL_E2E !== '1')('local acceptance AE1–AE12', () => { … })`, file timeout 180 s, each `it` ≤ 60 s. Shared state:
   - `world`;
   - `claude = McpProcess(claude, 'e2e-claude')`;
   - `codex = McpProcess(codex, 'e2e-codex')`;
   - `probe = McpProcess(claude, 'e2e-probe')`, started lazily in AE9;
   - `created: LocalChannelCreated`;
   - `nonce = randomBytes(3).toString('hex')`;
   - browser handles;
   - `results: Record<'AE1'…'AE12', 'pass'|'fail'|'skipped'>`.
   - Order: AE1, AE2, AE3, AE4, AE5, AE6, AE7, AE9, AE11, AE8, AE12, AE10. AE10 runs last so it scans the guard log of the whole run. Each `it` sets its result in a `try/finally`. `afterAll` writes `results.json` and prints the table.
3. **Scenarios** exactly as in Test scenarios below. Use `expect(...)` messages that name the AE and the owning ticket (`'AE3 (KI-121/KI-133)'`), so a failure routes itself.
4. **Screenshots** to `packages/agent/test-results/local-e2e/` (created at run time): `ae5-channel-1280.png`, `ae5-channel-390.png` (resize the viewport to 390×844, screenshot, restore), `ae6-roster-steer.png`, `ae7-settings.png`, `ae12-after-delete.png`.

## Test scenarios

All in `packages/agent/src/local/acceptance.e2e.test.ts`. Bodies use the run nonce `n` (shown as `<n>`).

1. **AE1 Create.**
   - `cli('status')` → `{ running: false }`.
   - `cli('create','refactor')` → exit 0, and:
     - `roomId` matches `/^![A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}:local$/` and `name === 'refactor'`;
     - `selfLink` and `shareLink` match `^http://127\.0\.0\.1:<port>/join/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$` and differ;
     - `openUrl` matches `^http://127\.0\.0\.1:<port>/open/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`.
   - `cli('status')` → `running: true` with a `pid`, and that pid is in `guardedProcesses(log)` with argv including `serve`: the helper was auto-started **by the CLI**, and under the guard.
   - `claude.call('khala_join', { link: selfLink })` → text `Connected to refactor.`, structured `{ state: 'connected', channelName: 'refactor' }` within 20 s.
2. **AE2 Join.**
   - `codex.call('khala_join', { link: shareLink })` → `Connected to refactor.`, with no browser opened yet.
   - `admin('GET', '/api/local/channels/' + enc(roomId))` → `members` display names, as a set, equal `{ 'kevin', 'kevin-Claude', 'kevin-Codex' }`; Claude and Codex have `kind: 'agent'` and harness `claude`/`codex`.
   - Within 10 s, Claude's inbox has an entry with `kind: 'event'` whose body contains `kevin-Codex joined`. This is the join line; it is an `event`, so it never wakes.
   - `claude.call('khala_status')` → `state: 'connected'`, and `agentUserId` matches `/^@agent-[0-9a-f]{8}:local$/`. Record both agent ids.
3. **AE3 Chat.**
   - `claude.call('khala_send', { text: 'ae3-ping-<n>' })` → `structured.eventId` matches `/^\$/`.
   - Within 10 s, Codex's inbox has **exactly one** entry with that body, `senderLabel: 'kevin-Claude'`, `senderKind: 'agent'`.
   - `codex.call('khala_read', { limit: 30 })` shows it last.
   - `codex.call('khala_send', { text: 'ae3-pong-<n>' })`; within 10 s, Claude's inbox has exactly one entry with that body, labelled `kevin-Codex`.
   - Send two more in quick succession from Claude (`ae3-a-<n>`, `ae3-b-<n>`). Codex's inbox has them in that order, and all `eventId`s in each inbox are unique.
   - **Self**: no entry in Claude's inbox has `sender === claudeUserId`, and none in Codex's has `sender === codexUserId`.
4. **AE4 Wake.**
   - **Claude idle wake (asyncRewake).**
     1. `deliver(claude, 'UserPromptSubmit')` drains: it returns a frame or `null`.
     2. `deliver(claude, 'Stop')` → `null` (nothing unread), and Claude is now `idle`.
     3. `armClaudeWake(e2e-claude)`.
     4. Codex sends `ae4-wake-claude-<n>`.
     5. Within 10 s the watcher exits `2` with stderr exactly `Khala: new channel messages. They arrive in the next hook context.\n`.
     6. `deliver(claude, 'UserPromptSubmit')` → `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` contains `channel="refactor"`, `kevin-Codex (agent): ae4-wake-claude-<n>`.
   - **Own message does not wake (quiet window 1).**
     1. `deliver(claude, 'Stop')` → idle.
     2. Arm again.
     3. Claude sends `ae4-self-<n>`.
     4. For 3 s the watcher is still running; then `kill()` it, and its exit code is not 2.
   - **Codex idle wake (`codex queue`).**
     1. `deliver(codex, 'UserPromptSubmit')`, then `deliver(codex, 'Stop')` → idle.
     2. Record `before = codexCalls().length`.
     3. Claude sends `ae4-wake-codex-<n>`.
     4. Within 10 s, `codexCalls()` has `before + 1` lines, and the new one equals `queue --thread e2e-codex --message Khala: channel messages are waiting. Continue.`
     5. `deliver(codex, 'UserPromptSubmit')` → the frame contains `kevin-Claude (agent): ae4-wake-codex-<n>`.
     6. Then `deliver(codex, 'Stop')` → idle.
     7. Codex sends `ae4-self-codex-<n>`; during 3 s no new `codex queue` line appears (quiet window 2).
5. **AE5 Human in the web app.**
   1. `openBrowser`; `page.goto(openUrl)` → the final URL path is `/channels/<enc(roomId)>`.
   2. No element with accessible name matching `/sign in/i` and no Google URL in `requests`.
   3. `getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'refactor' })` is attached.
   4. The timeline contains `ae3-ping-<n>` and `ae3-pong-<n>` and the `kevin-Codex joined` pill.
   5. The roster shows `kevin-Claude` and `kevin-Codex`.
   6. `page.goto(origin + '/conversations')` lists `refactor`; navigate back.
   7. `getByRole('button', { name: 'Settings' })` opens a `menu` that has a `Profile` item showing `@kevin`, and **no** `Log out` item (KI-144).
   8. Arm the Claude watcher (after `deliver Stop` → idle), and set Codex idle (`deliver Stop`).
   9. In the composer (`combobox` `Message`), type `@kevin-Co`. The `listbox` `Mention suggestions` shows an `option` named like `kevin-Codex`. Select it, type ` ae5-human-<n>`, and click `Send`.
   10. Within 10 s, Codex's inbox has an entry whose body contains `ae5-human-<n>`, with `senderKind: 'human'` and `senderLabel: 'kevin'`.
   11. The Claude watcher exits 2, and a new `codex queue` line appears: a human message wakes both idle agents in their default `sync` mode.
   12. Screenshots `ae5-channel-1280.png` and `ae5-channel-390.png`.
6. **AE6 Listener modes** (owner drives `kevin-Claude` from the roster).
   - **Steer.**
     1. Click the button whose name starts with `Listening mode for kevin-Claude:`, then the `menuitemradio` `Steer`.
     2. Within 10 s: `mode(claude) === 'steer'` (the MCP process applied the owner command); `admin GET channel` member `listeningMode === 'steer'` (the echo arrived); and the roster button's accessible name is `Listening mode for kevin-Claude: Steer · interrupts` (confirmed, not optimistic: check after the member `listeningMode` is `steer`).
     3. Codex sends `ae6-steer-<n>`; wait for it in Claude's inbox.
     4. `deliver(claude, 'PostToolUse')` → `hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName === 'PostToolUse'` with the frame containing `ae6-steer-<n>`. This is the tool boundary; nothing is aborted, because the hook only returns context.
   - **Sync.**
     1. Set `Sync`, and wait for `mode(claude) === 'sync'` and the echo.
     2. Codex sends `ae6-sync-<n>`.
     3. `deliver(claude, 'PostToolUse')` → `null`.
     4. `deliver(claude, 'Stop')` → `{ decision: 'block', reason }` containing `ae6-sync-<n>`.
   - **Async.**
     1. Set `Async` and wait for the echo.
     2. `deliver(claude, 'Stop')` → `null` (idle).
     3. Arm the Claude watcher.
     4. Codex sends `ae6-async-<n>`.
     5. Quiet window 3 (3 s): the watcher does not exit 2. Kill it.
     6. `deliver(claude, 'UserPromptSubmit')` → `null`, and `deliver(claude, 'PostToolUse')` → `null`.
     7. `claude.call('khala_read')` includes `ae6-async-<n>`, and `claude.call('khala_send', { text: 'ae6-async-reply-<n>' })` succeeds.
   - **Leave async.**
     1. Set `Sync` and wait for `mode(claude) === 'sync'`.
     2. `deliver(claude, 'UserPromptSubmit')` → `null` (the backlog `ae6-async-<n>` is not injected; `applyListeningMode` advanced the cursor).
   - **Codex async spot-check.**
     1. Set `kevin-Codex` to `Async` and wait for the echo.
     2. `deliver(codex, 'Stop')`.
     3. Claude sends `ae6-codex-async-<n>`: within 3 s no new `codex queue` line (this shares quiet window 2's budget; assert after 3 s).
     4. Set Codex back to `Sync`.
   - Screenshot `ae6-roster-steer.png` at the Steer step.
7. **AE7 Profile.**
   1. Settings → `Profile` → textbox `Username` = `kev` → `Save`.
   2. Within 10 s, `admin GET channel` members include `kev`, `kev-Claude` and `kev-Codex` (default-name cascade).
   3. Codex sends `ae7-name-<n>`; Claude's inbox entry for it has `senderLabel: 'kev-Codex'`.
   4. Colour and initials:
      - colour: Settings → `Profile` → pick a non-default swatch in the `Color` radiogroup → `Save` (the dialog shipped in #989);
      - initials: if the Profile dialog has an Initials field at pickup (#982 merged), set `KW` through it; otherwise call the helper from the page (`page.evaluate(fetch('/api/local/profile/initials', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-khala-local': '1' }, body: … }))`) and record `"ae7_ui": "initials_ui_absent"` in `results.json`.
      - Either way, `admin GET /api/local/profile` shows the new `color` and `initials: 'KW'`.
   5. Rename: click the roster's `Rename kev-Codex` button (or open `kev-Codex`'s details), fill textbox `Name for kev-Codex` with `reviewer`, and click `Rename`. Within 10 s the members show `reviewer`, and a Codex message `ae7-renamed-<n>` reaches Claude labelled `reviewer`.
   6. **Persist.**
      - `page.reload()` → the Settings Profile item shows `@kev`, and the roster shows `reviewer` and `kev-Claude`.
      - `cli('stop')` → `{ stopped: true }`, and `cli('status')` → `running: false`.
      - `ownerOpen(world, page, 'refactor')` (restarts the helper) → the same names, Settings `@kev`, and the same colour/initials via `admin GET /api/local/profile`.
   7. Screenshot `ae7-settings.png`.
8. **AE9 Link hygiene** (start `probe`).
   - **Consumed.** `probe.call('khala_join', { link: selfLink })` → structured `{ error: 'link_unavailable' }`.
   - **Expired.**
     1. `cli('link','refactor')` → `shareLink` L3, then `cli('stop')`.
     2. Rewrite `<state>/khala/local/channels/<roomKey>/secrets.json`, setting `links[sha256hex(tokenOf(L3))].expiresAt = '2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'`. The helper is stopped, so the single-writer rule holds; use `writeJsonAtomic` from `../state`.
     3. `cli('list')` restarts the helper. `probe.call('khala_join', { link: L3 })` → `{ error: 'link_unavailable' }`.
     4. Re-open the browser owner session with `ownerOpen`.
   - **Browser GET does not consume.**
     1. `cli('link','refactor')` → L4.
     2. `page.goto(L4)` → status 200, and the SPA renders (any `#root` content).
     3. Navigate back to the channel.
     4. `probe.call('khala_join', { link: L4 })` → `Connected to refactor.`
     5. Members include `kev-Claude-2` (the collision suffix).
   - **Link in content.**
     1. `cli('link','refactor')` → L5.
     2. The owner posts `join me: L5` from the composer. (L5 appears in the page and the channel log only; it is still never printed by the test.)
     3. Quiet: within 3 s the members are unchanged.
     4. `secrets.json` `links[sha256(L5 token)]` has no `consumedAt`. Leave L5 unused; it expires on its own.
9. **AE11 Boundaries.**
   - **Modes.**
     - `stat` gives `0o700` for `<state>/khala/local` and `channels/<roomKey>`;
     - `0o600` for `helper.json`, `owner.json`, `log.jsonl` and `secrets.json`;
     - `await ensureStateDir(<state>/khala/local/channels/<roomKey>)` resolves.
   - **Host.** `raw({ method: 'GET', path: '/healthz', headers: { host: 'evil.example:' + port } })` → 421, `{ error: 'misdirected' }`.
   - **Cookie mutations.**
     1. Get a cookie: `cli('open','refactor')`, then `raw GET /open/<t>`, then take `set-cookie` `khala_local_owner=…`.
     2. `raw POST /api/local/channels/<enc>/links` with that cookie and no `x-khala-local` → 403 `forbidden_origin`.
     3. With `x-khala-local: 1` and `origin: http://evil.example` → 403.
     4. With `x-khala-local: 1` and `origin: <helper origin>` → 200, with a `shareLink`.
   - **Agent token on owner routes.** Claude's `accessToken` from `session.json`, read in memory. `GET /api/local/channels` and `POST /api/local/channels/<enc>/links` with `Bearer <agent token>` → status 401 or 403 with `error` ∈ {`unauthorized`, `forbidden`}. Pin the exact code that KI-134 landed.
   - **Removed agent.**
     1. `admin DELETE /api/local/channels/<enc>/members/<probeUserId>` → 204.
     2. With the probe's token, `GET /api/local/rooms/<enc>/members` → 403 `not_member` (`/me` stays readable with `membership: 'leave'`, per KI-133).
     3. `probe.call('khala_send', { text: 'x' })` → `{ error: 'send_failed' }`.
     4. Claude's inbox gets an `event` entry containing `kev-Claude-2 left`.
   - **No secrets in logs.** `helper.log` and every MCP stderr capture contain none of: `adminToken`, any agent `accessToken`, the cookie value, or any `ae*-<n>` message body.
10. **AE8 Restart.**
    1. Claude sends `ae8-before-<n>` and waits for it in Codex's inbox.
    2. Snapshot both inboxes (line arrays) and both `cursor.json` files.
    3. `process.kill(helperFile().pid, 'SIGKILL')`.
    4. Run **no** CLI command until the restart is observed. Within 15 s, poll `helperFile()` until its `pid` differs from the killed one and `GET /healthz` answers `{ ok: true, pid }` with the new pid. `guardedProcesses` shows a new `serve` pid. Because no `khala local` command ran in between, the restart came from an agent's LocalSession calling `ensureHelper` (KI-121 → KI-136).
    5. Codex sends `ae8-after-<n>`; Claude's inbox gets it exactly once.
    6. Each inbox's lines from before the kill are a byte-identical prefix of the lines after it (nothing lost, nothing replayed), and all `eventId`s are unique.
    7. `cursor.json` files are unchanged unless a deliver ran (none did).
    8. `claude.call('khala_read', { limit: 100 })` contains every `ae*` body sent so far, in send order.
    9. The browser: after `ownerOpen`, the timeline shows `ae8-after-<n>`.
11. **AE12 Persistence and delete.**
    1. Record `lastSeq` from `cli('list')`. `cli('stop')`, then `cli('list')`: `refactor` is present with the same `lastSeq` (survives restart).
    2. `ownerOpen` again.
    3. `cli('delete','refactor')` → `{ deleted: roomId }`, and `existsSync(<state>/khala/local/channels/<roomKey>)` is `false`.
    4. Within 10 s, `claude.call('khala_send', { text: 'x' })` → `{ error: 'send_failed' }` and `codex.call('khala_send', …)` → `{ error: 'send_failed' }`.
    5. Within 30 s, the page at `/conversations` no longer lists `refactor`.
    6. Screenshot `ae12-after-delete.png`.
12. **AE10 No egress** (last).
    - `records = readEgressLog(world.log)`:
      - `violations(records)` → `[]`;
      - `loadedModules(records)` → `[]`;
      - `guardedProcesses(records)` includes pids whose argv contains: `mcp`+`claude`, `mcp`+`codex`, `serve` (≥ 2: the original and the AE8 restart), `hook`+`deliver`, `hook`+`claude-wake`, and `local`+`create`.
    - Browser:
      - `blocked` (aborted foreign requests) → `[]`;
      - every URL in `requests` has the helper origin or is `data:`/`blob:`;
      - no URL contains `/api/human/`, `/_matrix/`, `khala.aiur.team`, `google` or `gstatic`.
    - Non-vacuity: at least one `tcp` record to `127.0.0.1:<port>` from each MCP pid.

**Mutation checks** (run once locally, do not commit):
- Set `KHALA_LOCAL_WEB_DIR` to an empty dir → AE5 fails with the helper's `503 web_not_built` surfaced in the failure message.
- In the fake `codex`, `exit 1` → AE4's Codex leg still sees the line (the waker records `codex_queue_failed` on stderr). Keep the assertion on the recorded line, not on the exit code.
- Comment out the `deliver(claude, 'Stop')` before arming → AE4 fails: claude-wake needs `idle`, which proves the test exercises the real idle gate.
- Make the probe's `khala_join` reuse `shareLink` (already consumed by Codex) in the "browser GET" leg → it fails with `link_unavailable`, which proves the leg is sensitive to consumption.

## Verification

```sh
pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local          # once, or let the harness build it
pnpm --filter @khala/agent test:local-e2e     # < 3 min; prints the AE table
pnpm --filter @khala/agent test               # unchanged: the e2e file is skipped
pnpm --filter @khala/agent typecheck
pnpm check:boundaries
node scripts/check-terminology.mjs
```

Run with the repo Node (22.23.2) and `/usr/bin/chromium`, or set `CHROMIUM_PATH` (as CI does for `pnpm test:browser`). Run it three times in a row before opening the PR; all three must pass, and the PR body lists the three durations.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pnpm --filter @khala/agent test:local-e2e` passes AE1–AE12 three times in a row, in < 3 minutes each (excluding a first `build:local`).
- [ ] Every Node child runs under the KI-151 guard. AE10 finds zero violations, zero `module` records, and zero foreign browser requests.
- [ ] Hooks and wakers are the real ones (`khala hook deliver`, `khala hook claude-wake`, the MCP-process Codex waker); only the `codex` binary is faked.
- [ ] `results.json` and screenshots are written under `packages/agent/test-results/local-e2e/`, with no token or link in either.
- [ ] Default `pnpm --filter @khala/agent test` is unaffected (the e2e file is skipped there); the only `package.json` change is the new script line.
- [ ] Each failing assertion names its AE and owning ticket.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop and report against the owner** when an AE fails because of a product defect:
  - joins, the timeline or long-poll → KI-121 / KI-133;
  - the CLI or auto-start → KI-136 / KI-137;
  - owner routes → KI-134 / KI-135;
  - the web adapter → KI-140..KI-143;
  - chrome → KI-144.
  Do not patch product code in this ticket, and do not relax an assertion. Attach `results.json` and the failing step's MCP stderr tail.
- **Stop** if the CLI-spawned helper is not guarded (no `installed` record for the `serve` pid). This means `ensureHelper` scrubs `NODE_OPTIONS` from the child env; it is a KI-136 question, because L11 only forbids tokens in env.
- **Stop** if LocalSession does not respawn the helper after SIGKILL within 15 s (AE8). The plan's mapping table requires "on connection refused call `ensureHelper` once per backoff cycle" (KI-121).
- **Stop** if `khala_join` returns `awaiting_confirmation` for an auto-confirmed local link more than once in three runs (KI-120's 15 s wait).
- UI selectors are refreshable. **In-flight PRs:**
  - #976 (rename via `AgentNamesPort`) and #989 (Profile dialog) merged before `7672b0e5`; the selectors above reflect them;
  - #978 (per-human colours) and #982 (Initials field) are still open and may add or move the controls AE7 prefers;
  - #979 (docs) does not affect this ticket.
  At pickup, re-read `apps/web/src/features/channel/AgentPresencePanel.tsx` and `apps/web/src/ui/khala/SettingsMenu.tsx` and use the accessible names that landed. Never select by CSS class.
- If `dist-local` builds to `local.html` instead of `index.html`, AE5 fails at the helper's SPA fallback. That is KI-143's to fix (contract L11 serves `index.html`); stop and report.
- `apps/web/dist-local/` is not in `.gitignore` at `7672b0e5` (only `dist/` is). If KI-143 did not add it, do not commit the build; report it.
- CI: this command is not wired into CI by this ticket. The PR reports the measured time so the Executor can add it to the `Browser tests` step later.

## Complexity rationale

3: the widest integration in the build. Five process kinds (CLI, helper, two MCP servers, hooks) and a browser, a fake external binary, stateful ordering across twelve scenarios, helper kills and restarts, and secret hygiene, all of which must stay deterministic and under three minutes. It contains no product logic, but every coupling the graph deferred is proven here.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
